{{Quote|War does not come with a guarantee. No soldier gets the promise of safety, survival or victory. But men, I guarantee you this: every member of this clone youth brigade will have his moment. And it is that moment when you are no longer a cadet. You are a soldier.|Crasher|<ref name="Death Trap" />}}
The '''Clone Youth Brigade''' was a division within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and was made up of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] that were maturing to the position of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

==History==
A detachment from this group was infiltrated by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during a tour of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Jedi Cruiser]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. Young Fett was seeking revenge against [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Jango Fett/Legends|father]], and saw the ship tour as an opportunity to get close to Windu. Taking the callsign "Lucky", he was part of a Brigade division made up of [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]] [[Whiplash (Clone Youth Brigade)/Legends|Whiplash]], [[1151/Legends|1151]], [[Jax (clone cadet)/Legends|Jax]], [[Hotshot/Legends|Hotshot]] and a number of other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] on the ship. They were overseen by the clone [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Crasher/Legends|Crasher]], and were monitored by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]]. This troupe of young clones was forced to abandon the ''Endurance'' when it was sabotaged by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>
